title: AI in Disguise—Quasi-Experimental Analysis of a Large-Scale Deployment of AI-Generated Ads
authors: Yannick Exner; Jochen Hartmann; Ziqian Ding; Shunyuan Zhang; Oded Netzer
eligible_reason: No staggered DiD. The 'sibling ads' quasi-experiment compares AI-generated and human-made ad images launched by the same advertiser in the same campaign settings at the same time: ad-day CTR regressed on an effect-coded AI-image indicator (a fixed ad attribute, not a treatment that switches on over time) with cohort (glbl_cohort_id / camp_id / synd_id) and date fixed effects, impression weights, binomial logit (fixest::feglm) and a long list of ad/image/text controls. Nonlinear model, cross-sectional treatment, and no unit-specific adoption dates. The 'staggered' full-text hit refers to the gradual roll-out of the GenAI Ad Maker. The advertiser adoption regression is a cross-sectional logit.
design_notes: 01_formulas.R: v_ctr ~ ec_ai_image + ec_ai_title + text and image features (+ ec_ai_image * mc_looks_like_ai_01) | c_date + glbl_cohort_id (Table 1), variants with camp_id or synd_id FE; estimated by feglm(binomial logit, weights = v_impr, cluster = cohort). Stopping analyses use feols on ad-level survival-type outcomes. No post x treated interaction anywhere.
estimators_reported: weighted logit with cohort and date FE (fixest::feglm)
OLS/feols for perceived-artificiality drivers and stopping analyses
data_files: replication_package/masked_data.RData (syn_date, syn_inst, syn_camp, syn_synd, syn_img, syn_img_newer_model)
data_files_note: README: 'statistically masked data' derived from proprietary Taboola data: IDs anonymized, calendar dates replaced by relative day indices, impressions/clicks/conversions rescaled by a random campaign-level factor with stochastic rounding, spend rescaled with an additional ad-specific random factor; 'numerical estimates obtained from the released data need not exactly match those reported in the paper'. Recorded as synthetic (masked/rescaled), not original data.
software_notes: R (fixest feglm/feols, tidyverse), Quarto notebook replication.qmd.
priority_note: Not a DiD design; masked data.
screener_notes: Screened from package only (no article text).
